title: tussilago piloselloides
intro: Tussilago piloselloides, commonly known as woolly hawk's beard, is a flowering plant in the dandelion family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to help with bronchitis and coughs due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tussilago piloselloides include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its ability to soothe respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
